resources.string: Fills the fields you named into the current page form: only the fields you list, matched by label, then name, then placeholder — if one name hits several fields it stops and reports the ambiguity instead of guessing. Passwords, verification codes and one-time codes are never filled. It never submits: the Save / Submit / Login / Pay buttons are always yours to click, the tool only lists them. Every filled field returns one line of evidence (locator, before → after; phone-number-like values are masked). If one field fails it stops and restores what it already filled. Hidden by default: unlock the Browser group via capabilities first.
